reviews.text: Good store

Dr. Fernando and Dr. Guilherme are excellent veterinarians, providing humane and very attentive care. I took my dog ​​Mel there for her 17 years of life. I highly recommend this place.
Thank you.
Top-notch service!
Excellent customer service.

The staff are really friendly, but please instruct them not to follow customers around the store; it's awful and embarrassing. I wanted to look at more products to buy besides the pet food, but the guy stuck so close to me that I gave up.
I adore
Good prices on pet food and excellent customer service.
Large store with a wide variety of quality products. Helpful customer service.
Excellent service
Excellent!!
I loved!

I went on a Sunday, there was only one cashier, with two employees, one charging and the other packing, and the cashier next to it was empty. The line was huge, unfortunately with no employee to serve customers. The place is large. It has a variety of products. However, there were many small birds kept in cages displayed on the wall.
Excellent service and affordable prices.

The only thing that bothers me about this place is that they insisted so much that I register, claiming I would get a discount, but every time I've been to the store they haven't even offered to let me identify myself. I'm always the one asking: "And my discount?"
I liked the store, but the service wasn't that good.

Abusive pricing practice, March 3, 2026. Eye drops with a price difference. Photo attached. Identical product. Same expiration date. Being sold for R$ 192 at Cão Mania store.

While at Gege do Pet in Penha, the product is sold for R$ 115.

A huge difference. I questioned the manager and employees, but no discounts came close.

The same product is much cheaper online.

A shame. I won't go there anymore and I won't recommend buying there. Expensive place.
Very complete store. It has everything you need.

I've been a customer for many years and I know that those who pay with Pix (Brazil's instant payment system) are entitled to a 3% discount, but the cashiers don't apply it automatically, and I rarely question it because the amount is low, so I leave it as is. Today I asked them to set aside an order, and they set aside the wrong one. When I went to the store, thinking I would be helped because of a mistake that was the store's fault, I was treated with disdain by the cashier, who I believe is called Camila. She said I shouldn't give her the discount, but rather file a complaint. That's why I'm here. I just wanted her to give me the cash discount instead of charging me a measly 4 reais more for a product that you got wrong. She wanted to make a big fuss to give me the discount even though I was in a hurry, and I wasn't rude to her. You can check the security cameras and you'll see. I'm registering this so that if anyone else has a complaint about this person, you'll know what happened. And if any manager wants to talk to me to understand, I'm open to it. Thank you.
They just leave flyers on people's floors, forcing you to pick up physical spam. I don't buy from them because it's more expensive, not because I don't know the store exists.

I want to share my experience at Cão Mania Pet Shop, which surprised me in a very positive way! From the first interaction, the empathy and attentiveness of the staff were clear; they were always willing to guide, explain, and care for their pets with affection.

The space is truly complete. I found many product options, as well as services that greatly facilitate the routine of those who love their pets: an on-site veterinarian, a well-stocked pharmacy, and bathing and grooming done with care and patience.

It's an organized, complete, and trustworthy place that truly makes life easier for those seeking quality and good service. I recommend it for its structure, the diversity of products, and especially for the way they care for our animals.

What really caught my attention was the way they treat the animals, with respect, affection, and sensitivity, understanding that each pet has its own unique personality. This conveys security and confidence to those leaving a family member there.

Without a doubt, a pet shop that makes all the difference.
It's unfair to the customer to have their data forcibly collected for registration when all they want to do is buy and leave.

Good price but the delivery is slow... There's a lack of staff... The delivery person arrives late, around 5 pm, and says they haven't even had lunch yet... They need to hire more staff; you buy something and then you have to stay home waiting, sometimes all day... You can't even take a shower, otherwise they'll arrive... It's a disgrace... I just buy 15 kilos of dog food so I don't get stressed... and the cashier is the one who checks WhatsApp, sometimes it takes a while because she's doing her job, the delivery person has to keep checking WhatsApp because I want to know if it's going to take long and they say it's in the queue... You can't tell. Of course, they give the WhatsApp number to the wrong person. Give the delivery WhatsApp number to the delivery person; I want to know if I can go buy bread, take a shower, go to the pharmacy... This management is incredibly incompetent... At the end of the year, they were taking dogs to get bathed in the same car; they didn't even have time...
Excellent service, Valter and Alexandra were super helpful and friendly. Large store with a wide variety of products. I highly recommend it.

Excellent place...
They were especially attentive when bathing and grooming my dog.
Good price and lots of variety.

Just wanted to express my deepest gratitude for the amazing service and results from Estrelinha at the PetShop! She arrived smelling wonderful, beautifully groomed, and in perfect condition! Top-notch bath and grooming! From the WhatsApp service to the taxi driver... We are in love! Thank you so much. You've gained a new customer! ❤️

I do not recommend it, I do not recommend it. I took my dog, a husky, to get a bath, and he came back wet and full of knots that weren't even there before. However, they didn't dry him properly and he was still dirty. I found it strange that they bathed him so quickly. I chose the undercoat removal service, and they only removed it from one side; the other side is ridiculous. And to make matters worse, they dried him, or tried to, in the same place where they gave him the bath, which is why he came back still wet and full of knots. The side that was facing the wall is awful. I will never go back.
Excellent service. It's even better with the expansion.

Terrible, I took my cockatiel there with symptoms of diarrhea. They gave him medication that he inhaled and inflamed his lungs. He got worse after the medication. He had diarrhea before going but was eating normally. After seeing Dr. Fernando, he almost died; he went days without eating. I had to go to another place to improve his condition. I do not recommend this place.
I buy everything my animals need there. The service is exceptional in all areas, not to mention the grooming service which has a super special and caring team for the dogs!!!

Terrible. I booked a bath for my cat. When I arrived, the woman said she was going to trim his nails and then decide if she wanted to bathe him. Then she even mocked me, saying that if he was difficult, I shouldn't have brought him in for a bath. I always took him to the same place because his fur gets a lot of mites, causing allergies, but now the place near my house has closed, so I looked for a new one in the area, because I know this one doesn't even treat animals with respect. I took my cat home without touching her. Every job has its challenges, and not all animals are the same, but speaking to a client in that way shows, at the very least, a lack of preparation.
I always use the services and purchases for my dog.
Excellent pet shop. One of the best in Penha.
Wonderful store, lots of variety, good prices, and the staff are very helpful and polite.
I take my elderly dog ​​there and she receives excellent care during her baths.

I have been taking my two dogs (pugs) to the grooming service, and the second-to-last time, both came back damp, resulting in skin problems.
The second-to-last time, I repeatedly emphasized the importance of drying them well, both in writing and in person, to avoid future problems, and both came back dry.
However, today, unfortunately, they came back damp again, even after I asked them to dry them well and even after I stayed at the grooming location from 2:00 PM to 4:30 PM. Upon arrival, I had to finish drying them myself.
Note: When I asked if they were ready around 4:00 PM, they said they were finishing up because they were drying them!
Excellent service

I am writing to express my dissatisfaction with the service I received at the store. I scheduled an appointment for my pet's bath and grooming via WhatsApp, following the store's instructions, for the afternoon.

However, upon arrival, I was surprised to learn that the service would not be performed, with the justification that it "takes too long" and would have to be done in the morning, as it would be better for the animal and would require more attention. This caused great inconvenience, as I had organized my schedule according to the agreed-upon time, trusting in the store's commitment.

I would like to make it clear that the appointment was made following the team's instructions. I consider it disrespectful to cancel at the last minute, especially for a reason that should have been communicated at the time of scheduling.

I hope that situations like this do not happen again with other customers and that there will be more organization and commitment in future services.

Sincerely, PÉRSIA
I have always received good service.
Pet shop well located and with its own parking.
It has a wide variety of options. Easy to find and with parking. Prices are approximate.

I've been a customer since they opened, and I think they have the fairest prices in the area. Their WhatsApp service is fast and efficient. I'm currently without a car, and they make scheduling deliveries very easy. The delivery drivers are very attentive, as are the store employees. I highly recommend them ❤️🌹 …
Huge variety of both pet products and veterinary medicines. Fair prices. Huge parking lot and friendly staff. I will definitely return.
The veterinary clinic is great! I recommend it!
Otiima
They are always very attentive and enjoy helping.

First and last time I bathe my dog ​​at this place! His baths usually last an average of 40 minutes to an hour because he uses a therapeutic allergy shampoo, and the shampoo only needs to sit for 10 minutes. In short, the entire bath, including drying, only lasted 15 minutes! I don't recommend it; I hope he doesn't have any allergy problems because he wasn't dried properly!
Good place to shop.
Great price and lots of variety.
Excellent service with great prices and promotions.

I would like to express my sincere gratitude for the service provided today.
My four-legged love, Billy, has a very difficult temperament.
We had just returned from a trip. He was quite dirty and matted. I called several pet shops and informed them about his temperament. They said that if we couldn't handle it, they wouldn't do the service.
But at Cão Mania, the treatment was very different. From the appointment to the complete finalization of the care for my little one.
I know he's difficult, but we should at least try.
I was very happy with the result and the care that Fábio and Silvana gave him. I know he was a handful, but at no point did they bring me any complaints, unlike other pet shops where I took Billy.
Thank you again, Fábio and Silvana.
A very good place for your pet.

Absolutely everything I buy comes covered in dust in the packaging. Whether it's cat food sachets, dry food bags, or puppy pads, all the packaging is covered in dust. The staff don't seem to know much about what they're selling. Prices are okay.

Excellent service
Helpful people
Dr. Fernando is very good
It was well worth it
Excellent price
Good price

I've always received excellent service at this pet store. I've formed great friendships with the veterinarians, the staff, and with Alessandra, who has always treated me very well. My previous post regarding discounts was just a joke; I apologize.
I received good service. But there was a lack of organization among the employees themselves.

The store is located in a good location, easily accessible thanks to its two entrances and ample parking. The store is large and has a wide variety of products. The employees are very attentive and helpful; as soon as you enter the store, …
It has everything I need and the prices are fair.

On November 7th, I was there with my mother and my dog ​​to buy pet food. While walking around, we saw some cages, and since we have a cockatiel, we thought about buying a larger cage. However, none of the cages had a price tag, and those …
Good service
Very good! I recommend it!

Great store and great service!

Whenever I need anything, I'll be there...
Excellent
